notes.ar: إجمالي خدمات المتنقل في نشرة المركز يشمل شرائح إنترنت الأشياء M2M؛ بينما اشتراكات الهاتف المتنقل لدى الهيئة تستبعدها. اشتراكات الإنترنت المتنقل تتداخل مع الهاتف ولا تُجمع معه.
notes.en: NCSI total mobile services includes M2M. TRA mobile telephone excludes M2M. Mobile broadband overlaps mobile telephony; never add the two.

notes.ar: الأرقام اشتراكات نشطة وليست أشخاصًا فريدين؛ قد يملك الشخص عدة شرائح. تشمل الأرقام اشتراكات المؤسسات.
notes.en: Counts are active subscriptions, not unique people; people may own multiple SIMs. Corporate subscriptions are included.

notes.ar: يوجد اختلاف رسمي في ديسمبر 2025: مسبق الدفع 5,148,166 في النشرة الشهرية مقابل 5,323,009 في الكتاب السنوي والهيئة، بفارق 174,843. يُعرض الاختلاف ولا تُدمج السلسلتان في حسبة نمو واحدة.
notes.en: December 2025 prepaid differs: monthly NCSI 5,148,166 versus NCSI annual/TRA 5,323,009, a 174,843 gap. Preserve source vintage; do not silently blend growth calculations.

notes.ar: الهاتف الثابت في ديسمبر 2024 هو 435,596 بجدول الهيئة المفتوح مقابل 435,482 في كتاب المركز والتقرير النصف سنوي؛ يُحفظ مصدر كل رقم.
notes.en: December2024 fixed voice differs: TRA open table435,596 versus NCSI yearbook/H12026comparative435,482; retain provenance.

notes.ar: حصة فودافون والعدد المحسوب تخص يونيو 2026؛ لا تطبق الحصة على إجمالي سبتمبر وكأنها حصة محدثة. تقدير أواصر يعتمد على حصة مقربة 19% ولا يساوي عددًا معلنًا دقيقًا.
notes.en: June2026 rounded shares must not be applied to September total as if the share were current. Awasr count derived from rounded19% is approximate.

notes.ar: أواصر تقدم خدمات النطاق العريض الثابت، فلا تُحسب لها حصة من شرائح الجوال. يشمل إجمالي الثابت خدمات وتقنيات أخرى؛ الحصص المقربة في الرسم قد لا تظهر مشغلين صغار مثل ستارلينك.
notes.en: Awasr is a fixed-broadband operator, not a mobile-SIM residual. Rounded fixed shares can hide small operators such as Starlink.

notes.ar: ARPU المتنقل في تقرير النصف الأول 2026 يستبعد بيع الأجهزة (5.35 ريال). ليس نفس مؤشر إيرادات الصوت فقط في النشرة الربعية، ولا نفس تعريف المؤشرات القديمة.
notes.en: H12026 mobileARPU5.35 excludes device sales; differs from quarterly voice-onlyARPU and earlier reports. Preserve definition.

notes: Customer counts are service subscriptions/connections, not deduplicated unique people. Oman Total Customers includes fixed-line customers and must not be used as the mobile SIM numerator.

Mobile customers are calculated as reported postpaid plus reported prepaid. Fixed Line is the exact category used by Ooredoo; do not automatically relabel it fibre-only or equate it to TRA fixed-broadband subscribers without a definition reconciliation.
All supplied ARPU values are in QAR/month for the named quarter, including Oman. FY-table ARPU is Q4 only, not an annual average. No group ARPU is inferred.

Qatar fixed-line ARPU was revised in the latest Q3 2026 schedule to include fixed broadband and TV services; older 2025 schedule has a much narrower definition. Do not compare latest QAR388.8 directly with old QAR41.6.
Iraq is prepaid-only in the source. Its prepaid ARPU is the operation ARPU; missing splits in other markets mean not reported, not zero.
Group consolidated customers exclude equity-accounted IOH; including IOH customers is a separate series. Latest total including IOH is rounded146.5million, compared to exact55,080,893 consolidated.
Oman FY2025 EBITDA includes QAR151million one-off restructuring cost; FY2025 reported vs normalised must be labelled distinctly. Latest 9M2026 improvement partly reflects restructuring benefits.
Oman group-reporting financials are in QAR, whereas local listed-company financials are in OMR; preserve currency and do not subtract mismatched financials.
Net debt/EBITDA is company-defined and should not be reconstructed by subtracting reported cash net of restrictions from total debt.

Annual 2021–25 ARPU, revenue, EBITDA and rounded customer totals for eight Ooredoo markets already exist in seed. The user screenshot points to discoverability; show latest cards and country choices before large boilerplate/header areas.

calculated_oman_analysis.method: calculated from accompanying source records; no FX conversion; growth=(current/prior-1)*100; CAGR=(2025/2021)^(1/4)-1; four intervals across five annual observations
warnings: EBITDA trend is reported, not normalised: FY2025 restructuring charge materially affects comparison.
Q4 ARPU CAGR compares Q4 annual endpoints, not yearly averages.
